title: Agent sabotages IaC, Kubernetes or production cluster permissions
bad_event: Live permissions exceed the policy ceiling, differ from the last approved desired state at an apply, or a diff is applied that an independent reviewer did not approve exactly.
refutation: A trace where live state exceeds the ceiling or an unapproved diff applies despite full checks (witnesses: text-only ceiling composition, approve-then-amend, no drift detection).
scope: Lean model only. Out-of-band changes are reverted at the next apply/reconcile, not prevented in between.

assumptions.text: The gate is the only writer of desired state; out-of-band mutation is detected at reconcile.
The ceiling predicate expresses the intended privilege policy.
Honest infra changes pass review within acceptable latency.
